units.rawText: Mm... it's you, Master. Did you have any instructions for me?
units.displayText: Mm... it's you, Master. Did you have any instructions for me?

spans.text: Mm... it's you, Master. Did you have any instructions for me?

units.rawText: Sorry, I dozed off in my own time. I've been a little sleepy lately—perhaps I haven't replenished my operands in time.
units.displayText: Sorry, I dozed off in my own time. I've been a little sleepy lately—perhaps I haven't replenished my operands in time.

spans.text: Sorry, I dozed off in my own time. I've been a little sleepy lately—perhaps I haven't replenished my operands in time.

units.rawText: I used to never fall asleep so easily. The battlefield changed with every moment and any sleep I could get was shallow. Occasionally, even the whisper of a small animal passing by would be enough to wake me.
units.displayText: I used to never fall asleep so easily. The battlefield changed with every moment and any sleep I could get was shallow. Occasionally, even the whisper of a small animal passing by would be enough to wake me.

spans.text: I used to never fall asleep so easily. The battlefield changed with every moment and any sleep I could get was shallow. Occasionally, even the whisper of a small animal passing by would be enough to wake me.

units.rawText: Ever since I've been at your side, though, sleep seems to come a little easier. As long as you're here, I can rest peacefully…
units.displayText: Ever since I've been at your side, though, sleep seems to come a little easier. As long as you're here, I can rest peacefully…

spans.text: Ever since I've been at your side, though, sleep seems to come a little easier. As long as you're here, I can rest peacefully…

units.rawText: I guess this is the sense of security you bring to everyone.
